name: Hover Image Preview
description: Paragraph with highlighted inline links that reveal a floating image lens following the cursor with eased motion and inner parallax when a link is hovered.
contents: Paragraph of text with inline highlighted links
Floating image lens that follows the cursor
behavior: Lens trails the pointer with eased animation and the image inside shifts with parallax
Hovering a link expands the lens from a small dot to a rounded image card and crossfades images
Surrounding text dims while the lens is shown
On touch, tapping a link toggles the lens and touch position moves it
